components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button — dialog submits, primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-brand); color: var(--color-bg-base); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: var(--font-manrope); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/cancel action — no background at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-muted); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: var(--font-manrope); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-text-primary); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--color-bg-elevated); color: var(--color-text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: var(--font-manrope); font-size: 0.875rem; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-brand); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-brand); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status/source pill — dot plus label, color never alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: var(--font-manrope); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge-success { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-success) 10%, transparent); color: var(--color-success); }

narrative.overview: Apprise's dashboard reads as an organic surface with something growing underneath it, not a static admin console. The base is a near-black forest floor, lit from one corner by a soft green glow that never fully resolves into a shape — the same radial gradient sits behind the sidebar and the page body, tying every screen back to one ambient light source. A faint crack-pattern texture sits under the sidebar and the page at 6-9% opacity: enough to read as ground with structure to it, never enough to compete with content. Onto that surface, individual elements pick up a colored glow of their own when active or interactive, as if catching light from the same source rather than being told to look important via a drop shadow. This system explicitly rejects the generic AI-SaaS dashboard and the cluttered enterprise-admin panel. Apprise is infrastructure for a self-organising agent workforce; the interface should feel alive and precise at once.
keyCharacteristics: Dark forest-green base with a single ambient glow source, not a flat black or navy
Flat surfaces at rest; glow (not shadow darkness) signals elevation and interactivity
A crack-pattern ground texture underneath everything, always subtle
Space Grotesk for anything that names or labels a section; Manrope for everything read at length; JetBrains Mono for anything code-shaped
Motion is a signal of underlying state — never decoration layered on top of static content

rules.name: The Agent Accent Rotation
rules.body: Every agent gets one of Forest 600 / Violet Accent / Amber Highlight, deterministically hashed from its ID, applied to avatar, hover ring, and node glow. Placeholder mechanic, not locked — moving toward unique per-agent organic identities later.

rules.name: The One Light Source Rule
rules.body: Every glow in the interface reads as light from the same origin. Don't introduce a second, differently-colored glow source; extend the existing one.

rules.name: The Naming Font Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk appears only on things that name or title something. Everything else stays in Manrope. Don't reach for Space Grotesk for emphasis; use weight instead.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is never communicated by a darker shadow or lighter surface. It's communicated by a colored glow appearing where there wasn't one.

dos: Do use a colored glow to signal hover/interactive state on cards and nodes, sourced from the same ambient light direction as the page background.
Do keep Space Grotesk scoped to things that name or title something; everything else is Manrope.
Do pair every status/state signal with a non-color cue.
Do let the per-agent accent color carry through avatar, ring, and glow consistently for a given agent.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest — border only, no shadow.
donts: Don't use cream, beige, or any warm near-white background.
Don't use gradient text or background-clip: text for emphasis.
Don't build identical stat-tile grids or a generic hero-metric template.
Don't add drop-shadow-based elevation to cards or panels.
Don't introduce a second ambient glow color distinct from the existing forest-green corner glow.
Don't treat the current three-color Agent Accent Rotation as permanent.
